name: chinese-commit-conventions
tagline_zh: 写英文 commit 总卡壳？这套中文模板让提交信息像发朋友圈一样顺。自带 commitlint 规则和 chan。
tagline_en: Struggling with English commits? This Chinese template makes commit messages flow like a chat. Includes.
desc_en: 中文 commit 与 changelog 配置参考——Conventional Commits 中文适配、commitlint/husky/commitizen 中文模板、conventional-changelog 中文配置。仅在用户显式 /chinese-commit-conventions 时调用，不要根据上下文自动触发。
why_zh: 同类工具只给英文示例，它却把 commitizen 和 changelog 全中文化。
why_en: Unlike English-only guides, it localizes commitizen and changelog fully, even adapting punctuation habits—truly plug-and-play.
